messages.subject: IPM Workshop in France in the Fall 2020 will take place !
parts:
Dear all,

 

apologies for another mail about this, but well, it's been crazy times. So: the Integrated Population Modeling (IPM) workshop that we had advertised for November 2020 in Montpellier/France will take place (of course, barring any exceptionalities such as a big 2nd wave). Here is the key information again; more extensive information, including how to register, is in the attachment. Venez nombreux !

 

Intermediate-level workshop: Bayesian integrated population modelling (IPM) using JAGS

 

Instructors:     Michael Schaub & Marc Kéry, Swiss Ornithological Institute, Sempach, Switzerland; Olivier Gimenez & Maud Quéroué, CEFE, CNRS, Montpellier, France

Date:                23 – 27 November 2020

Venue:             Centre d'Ecologie fonctionelle et evolutive (CEFE), CNRS, Montpellier, France



Best regards  --- Michael, Marc, Olivier & Maud
